samples.question: The picture shows a REFERENCE bar and two candidate bars labeled A and B. Every bar is divided by two vertical boundaries into three side-by-side sections: an indigo section on the left, a turquoise section in the middle, and an amber section on the right. The bars have different total lengths, so their section widths differ too. In the REFERENCE bar, the middle section's width divided by the left section's width gives a certain ratio. Exactly one candidate reproduces this same middle-to-left ratio; the other candidate uses a clearly different ratio. Which candidate, A or B, has the same middle-to-left ratio as the REFERENCE? Answer A or B.
